Proposal 3. Approval, in a Non-Binding Advisory Vote, of the Compensation for Named Executive Officers

The Board believes that the compensation of our named executive officers ("NEOs") as disclosed in this Proxy Statement for FY25 is well aligned with VIAVI's performance and the interests of our stockholders.
The Compensation Committee and the Board believe that it is in the best interest of stockholders to approve the amendment and restatement of our 2003 Equity Incentive Plan.
By Order of the Board of Directors,
Our commitment to designing an executive compensation program that is consistent with responsible financial and risk management is reflected in the following policies and practices:
▪ Compensation Committee is comprised 100% of independent Directors.
▪ Independent compensation consultant retained by the Compensation Committee.
▪ Performance-based annual equity awards comprising approximately 60% of the overall equity allocation to the Chief Executive Officer ("CEO") and 50% to the rest of the NEOs.
▪ Solicit an annual advisory vote on named executive officer compensation.
▪ No employment agreements that provide for multi-year guarantees of salary increases, bonuses, or equity compensation without further Board or Compensation Committee approval.
On behalf of the Board of Directors, we would like to express our appreciation for your continued support of VIAVI.
